text:
sasha: Quick check — ran into an OOM in the small-batch ramp tests when the soft-lane evictor used a fixed 2s grace. Hotset was shifting a lot; evictions seemed too eager + too late at different times. Any thoughts on making the grace period adaptive?

matt: Can you paste the repro and any traces? Was spillback or host fallback triggered?

sasha: repro attached (local stress): ~300 req/s windows, hotset shifts ~every 400ms. Trace snippet:
```
[evictor] demote tenant=42 slab=hotset_change delta=+120ms
[alloc] OOM fallback -> host-backed
[evictor] grace_ms=2000 demote_attempt=1
```
Looks like by the time demote finishes the hotset moved again and we hit fallback.

li: Fixed grace is fragile when hotset volatility > grace. Idea: make grace = scale * EWMA(hotset_churn_ms). If churn spikes, grace grows; if stable, it shrinks.

ana: We also need tenant fairness — high-volatility tenants shouldn't keep others waiting. Maybe multiply by tenant_weight = 1 / (1 + recent_qps_norm) or clamp per-tenant.

sasha: @li can you sketch the EWMA formula? Also how expensive is computing hotset_churn at runtime?

li: churn_t = |hotset_fingerprint_t - hotset_fingerprint_{t-1}| measured every W ms; EWMA_churn = alpha * churn_t + (1-alpha)*EWMA_churn_{t-1}. We already compute a cheap hotset fingerprint every 200ms for eviction heuristics so we can piggyback. Cost is negligible (cached bloom/fingerprint diff).

matt: Edgecases: warmups produce very high churn; we shouldn't set infinite grace. Add min/max clamps and an aging factor so after X seconds we favor eviction. Also ensure we don't violate tenant SLOs.

ana: Proposed defaults: min_grace=50ms, max_grace=3000ms, alpha=0.25, scale=1.5. Weighting: grace *= clamp(1 - tenant_activity_norm, 0.5, 1.2).

sasha: Plan: prototype adaptive grace = clamp(scale * EWMA_churn, min, max) * tenant_weight. I'll open a branch. Tests to add?

li: Unit tests for churn->grace mapping, integration test with artificially bursty workloads verifying no OOM regressions + fairness metric (latency tail per-tenant). Also test warmup scenario where EWMA ramps from high to low.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: CI passed for branch adaptive-evict-grace-174; canary to staging evicters started :rocket:

sasha: Thanks. Telemetry follow-up: emit evict_grace_ms per-tenant, hotset_churn_ms, and a tag 'grace_mode=adaptive|fixed' so we can compare.

ana: Also add a 'grace_reason' tag with values min_clamped / max_clamped / weight_adjusted / normal for easier queries.

matt: +1. Can we do a short RFC follow-up 1-pager listing the formula, knobs, tradeoffs, and expected SLO impacts? We'll need it for Dedicated customers.

sasha: On it — will draft and ping for review. :thumbsup:
